question: For loanDepot (NYSE: LDI) what is the breakdown of loan originations between purchases and refinancings for the last 9 months as of 11/12/2024?
model_answer:
For the nine months ended **September 30, 2024** (10-Q filed **November 12, 2024**), loanDepot’s loan origination volume was **$17.308 billion**, broken down as:

| Origination purpose | Volume | % of total |
|---|---:|---:|
| Purchase | **$12.058 billion** | **69.7%** |
| Refinance — cash-out | $4.661 billion | 26.9% |
| Refinance — rate/term | $0.590 billion | 3.4% |
| **Total refinancings** | **$5.250 billion** | **30.3%** |
| **Total originations** | **$17.308 billion** | **100%** |

So purchases were about **70%** of volume, while refinancings were about **30%**—mostly cash-out refinancings.

Source: loanDepot Form 10-Q for the quarter ended Sept. 30, 2024, and Q3 2024 earnings release.
judge_reason: Both purchase and refinance originations are pure roundings of the official values, with no contradiction.
